in_english.name: Ghunaah
in_english.long_meaning: Ghunaah is a female given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'beautiful voice' or 'singing'. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'غ-ن-ي' (ghayn-nun-yah), it relates to concepts of melody and vocal beauty. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root appears in discussions of aesthetic and spiritual expression. Historically, the name Ghunaah has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify elegance and vocal charm. It symbolizes the attribute of having a beautiful voice or expressing oneself melodiously.
